panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 2 panels (A, B). A: Real clinical photograph of severe LAD I showing skin lesions without pus, consistent with captioned disease manifestation. [raw subtype: LAD I] B: Real clinical photograph of severe LAD I showing non-purulent necrotic skin lesions, matching the caption. [raw subtype: LAD I]
